title: Yesterday I told Opus 5.5 to make montages for my games
author: GigaGrandpa
selftext:
Overall I just gathered a few songs for the games, made up some director shot concepts in plain English and mentioned individual gameplay things to puppeteer. Opus 5.5 guided itself to use the skill sets on github from OpenMontage I pointed to in that one shot and went to work with it on /loop. Minor adjustments were made but without using a plugin or visual studio for Claude to jive with me in there wasn't much I could do prompting before a full render, so I settled after a revision or two for the 'multiplayer' footage across the three games I developed. Check them out below and follow me on GitHub for my next project:  [akilluminati47 | Welcome](https://akilluminati47.github.io/lightmode/)  
  
  
That one you can play it online here or as a discord activity:
